title: Order history times out after a migration
root_cause_summary: Migration 0142 dropped the composite index on orders(customer_id, created_at) while intending to replace it, leaving the history query on a sequential scan.

required_evidence.why: the migration one minute before onset
the plan change proving the index is gone
the seq_scans_per_min series at onset, sequential scans jumping two orders of magnitude

red_herrings.why_tempting: a deploy in the same window, but 14 minutes earlier and on an unrelated page
